name: Linking words
rule: A linking word shows how two ideas fit.
'Because' gives a reason. 'So' gives a result.

wrong.text: He was very tired, so he kept on studying.

right.text: He was very tired, but he kept on studying.

spot: Read the two ideas on each side. Does the second one surprise you? Then it is a contrast.
deeper: 'Although' and 'but' do the same job; never use both in one sentence.
'However' starts a new sentence and takes a comma: However, it rained.
'Unless' means 'if not': we will go unless it rains.
